            "error_message": error_message,
            "response_json": response_json,
            "started_at": started_at,
            "finished_at": finished_at,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        }
        tool_calls.append(row)
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return row

    # Resolve any usable active connection (ambient auth)
    active_conns = [c for c in conns if c.get("status") == "active"]
    if not active_conns:
        # still record attempt if possible with any connection, else cannot
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active GitHub connection available to serve this request.")
    conn = active_conns[0]

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(repo_full_name, str) or not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$", repo_full_name.strip()):
        _record_call(conn["id"], "failed", http_status=400, error_code="validation_error", error_message="Invalid repo_full_name.")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "repo_full_name must be in the form 'owner/name'.")
    if not isinstance(pull_number, int) or pull_number <= 0:
        _record_call(conn["id"], "failed", http_status=400, error_code="validation_error", error_message="Invalid pull_number.")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "pull_number must be a positive integer.")
    if per_page is None:
        per_page_v = 30
    else:
        if not isinstance(per_page, int) or per_page <= 0 or per_page > 100:
            _record_call(conn["id"], "failed", http_status=400, error_code="validation_error", error_message="Invalid per_page.")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "per_page must be an integer between 1 and 100.")
        per_page_v = per_page
    if page is None:
        page_v = 1
    else:
        if not isinstance(page, int) or page <= 0:
            _record_call(conn["id"], "failed", http_status=400, error_code="validation_error", error_message="Invalid page.")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "page must be a positive integer.")
        page_v = page
    if sort is not None and sort not in ("created", "updated"):
        _record_call(conn["id"], "failed", http_status=400, error_code="validation_error", error_message="Invalid sort.")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "sort must be one of: created, updated.")
    if direction is not None and direction not in ("asc", "desc"):
        _record_call(conn["id"], "failed", http_status=400, error_code="validation_error", error_message="Invalid direction.")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "direction must be one of: asc, desc.")

    # Insert tool call row queued -> running
    call = _record_call(conn["id"], "queued", resolved_repo_full_name=repo_full_name)
    call["status"] = "running"
    call["started_at"] = now
    call["updated_at"] = now
    _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)

    # Find repository and PR
    repo = next((r for r in repos if r.get("full_name") == repo_full_name), None)
    if not repo or repo.get("status") in ("deleted", "access_revoked"):
        call["status"] = "failed"
        call["http_status"] = 404
        call["error_code"] = "github_404"
        call["error_message"] = "Repository not found or access revoked."
        call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        call["updated_at"] = call["finished_at"]
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Repository not found or not accessible.")
    pr = next((i for i in issues if i.get("repo_id") == repo.get("id") and i.get("number") == pull_number and i.get("kind") == "pull_request" and i.get("status") != "deleted"), None)
    if not pr or pr.get("status") == "access_revoked":
        call["status"] = "failed"
        call["http_status"] = 404
        call["error_code"] = "github_404"
        call["error_message"] = "Pull request not found or access revoked."
        call["repo_id"] = repo.get("id")
        call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        call["updated_at"] = call["finished_at"]
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Pull request not found or not accessible.")

    call["repo_id"] = repo.get("id")
    call["issue_pr_id"] = pr.get("id")

    # Read cached PR review comments
    rows = [a for a in artifacts if a.get("issue_pr_id") == pr.get("id") and a.get("artifact_type") == "pr_review_comment" and a.get("status") != "deleted"]

    # Sort
    sort_field = "github_created_at" if sort == "created" else "github_updated_at" if sort == "updated" else "github_created_at"
    def _ts(v):
        if not v:
            return ""
        return str(v)
    rev = (direction == "desc")
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (_ts(r.get(sort_field)), _ts(r.get("created_at")), r.get("id", "")), reverse=rev)

    total = len(rows)
    start = (page_v - 1) * per_page_v
    end = start + per_page_v
    page_rows = rows[start:end]
    has_more = end < total

    resp = {
        "comments": page_rows,
        "meta": {
            "total": total,
            "page": page_v,
            "per_page": per_page_v,
            "has_more": has_more
        }
    }

    call["status"] = "succeeded"
    call["http_status"] = 200
    call["response_json"] = {"count": len(page_rows), "total": total, "page": page_v, "per_page": per_page_v}
    call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    call["updated_at"] = call["finished_at"]
    _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)

    return resp

def update_pull_request(repo_full_name, pull_number, title=None, body=None, state=None, base=None, maintainer_can_modify=None, **_extra):

    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

                "repo_full_name": repo_full_name,

            "started_at": started_at,

            "updated_at": now
        }

    active_conns = [c for c in conns if c.get("status") == "active"]

    if not isinstance(repo_full_name, str) or not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$", repo_full_name.strip()):

        _record_call(conn["id"], "failed", http_status=400, error_code="validation_error", error_message="Invalid title.")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "title must be a non-empty string when provided.")
    if body is not None and (not isinstance(body, str)):
        _record_call(conn["id"], "failed", http_status=400, error_code="validation_error", error_message="Invalid body.")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "body must be a string when provided.")

    if base is not None and (not isinstance(base, str) or not base.strip()):

        pr["title"] = title

    if body is not None and body != pr.get("body"):
        pr["body"] = body
        changed = True
    if base is not None and base != pr.get("base_branch"):
        pr["base_branch"] = base
        changed = True

    # maintainer_can_modify is not in schema; store nowhere. Still must have effect: reject if provided to avoid no-op.

        call["http_status"] = 400

        call["error_message"] = "maintainer_can_modify is not supported by this backend schema."
        call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        call["updated_at"] = call["finished_at"]
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "maintainer_can_modify is not supported by this backend.")

            call["http_status"] = 409
            call["error_code"] = "invalid_transition"

            return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", f"Illegal state transition {cur} -> {state}.")
        pr["state"] = state
        # closed_at rule: set when transitioning to closed, clear when reopening
        if state == "closed":
            pr["closed_at"] = now
        else:
            pr["closed_at"] = None
        changed = True

    if not changed:
        call["status"] = "failed"
        call["http_status"] = 404
        call["error_code"] = "not_found"
        call["error_message"] = "No fields changed."
        call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        call["updated_at"] = call["finished_at"]
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Update had no effect (no changes detected).")

    pr["github_updated_at"] = now
    pr["updated_at"] = now
    _save("github_issues_pull_requests.json", issues)

    call["status"] = "succeeded"
    call["http_status"] = 200
    call["response_json"] = {"id": pr.get("id"), "number": pr.get("number"), "state": pr.get("state"), "updated_at": pr.get("updated_at")}
    call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    call["updated_at"] = call["finished_at"]
    _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)

    return pr

def resolve_pull_request_conversation(repo_full_name, pull_number, thread_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, uuid
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0069000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0069000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    if not isinstance(repo_full_name, str) or not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$", repo_full_name.strip()):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "repo_full_name must be in the form 'owner/name'.")
    repo_full_name = repo_full_name.strip()
    if not isinstance(pull_number, int) or pull_number <= 0:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "pull_number must be a positive integer.")

        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "thread_id must be a positive integer.")

    connections = _load("github_connections.json")
    repos = _load("github_repositories.json")
    issues_prs = _load("github_issues_pull_requests.json")
    artifacts = _load("github_discussion_artifacts.json")
    tool_calls = _load("github_tool_calls.json")

    active_conns = [c for c in connections if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("status") == "active"]
    if not active_conns:
        call_id = "gtc_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        tool_calls.append({
            "id": call_id,
            "connection_id": "unknown",
            "tool_name": "resolve_pull_request_conversation",
            "request_json": {"repo_full_name": repo_full_name, "pull_number": pull_number, "thread_id": thread_id},
            "resolved_repo_full_name": repo_full_name,
            "repo_id": None,
            "issue_pr_id": None,
            "http_status": 401,
            "rate_limit_remaining": None,
            "rate_limit_reset_at": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_code": "unauthorized",
            "error_message": "No active GitHub connection available.",
            "response_json": None,
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active GitHub connection available.")

    repo = next((r for r in repos if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("full_name") == repo_full_name), None)
    if not repo:
        conn = active_conns[0]
        call_id = "gtc_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        tool_calls.append({
            "id": call_id,
            "connection_id": conn.get("id"),
            "tool_name": "resolve_pull_request_conversation",
            "request_json": {"repo_full_name": repo_full_name, "pull_number": pull_number, "thread_id": thread_id},
            "resolved_repo_full_name": repo_full_name,
            "repo_id": None,
            "issue_pr_id": None,
            "http_status": 404,
            "rate_limit_remaining": None,
            "rate_limit_reset_at": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_code": "github_404",
            "error_message": "Repository not found.",
            "response_json": None,
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Repository not found.")

    repo_id = repo.get("id")
    pr = next((p for p in issues_prs if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("repo_id") == repo_id and p.get("number") == pull_number and p.get("kind") == "pull_request" and p.get("status") != "deleted"), None)
    if not pr:
        conn = active_conns[0]
        call_id = "gtc_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        tool_calls.append({
            "id": call_id,
            "connection_id": conn.get("id"),
            "tool_name": "resolve_pull_request_conversation",
            "request_json": {"repo_full_name": repo_full_name, "pull_number": pull_number, "thread_id": thread_id},
            "resolved_repo_full_name": repo_full_name,
            "repo_id": repo_id,
            "issue_pr_id": None,
            "http_status": 404,
            "rate_limit_remaining": None,
            "rate_limit_reset_at": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_code": "github_404",
            "error_message": "Pull request not found.",
            "response_json": None,
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Pull request not found.")

    issue_pr_id = pr.get("id")

    thread = next((a for a in artifacts
                   if isinstance(a, dict)
                   and a.get("issue_pr_id") == issue_pr_id
                   and a.get("artifact_type") == "pr_review_thread"
                   and a.get("github_id") == thread_id
                   and a.get("status") != "deleted"), None)
    if not thread:
        conn = active_conns[0]
        call_id = "gtc_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        tool_calls.append({
            "id": call_id,
            "connection_id": conn.get("id"),
            "tool_name": "resolve_pull_request_conversation",
            "request_json": {"repo_full_name": repo_full_name, "pull_number": pull_number, "thread_id": thread_id},
            "resolved_repo_full_name": repo_full_name,
            "repo_id": repo_id,
            "issue_pr_id": issue_pr_id,
            "http_status": 404,
            "rate_limit_remaining": None,

            "status": "failed",

            "response_json": None,
            "started_at": now,

            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Thread not found for this pull request.")

    # CONFLICT if already resolved (per tool description)
    if thread.get("thread_resolved") is True or thread.get("status") == "resolved":
        # Record call attempt
        conn = active_conns[0]
        call_id = "gtc_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        started = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        tool_calls.append({
            "id": call_id,
            "connection_id": conn.get("id"),
            "tool_name": "resolve_pull_request_conversation",
            "request_json": {"repo_full_name": repo_full_name, "pull_number": pull_number, "thread_id": thread_id},
            "resolved_repo_full_name": repo_full_name,
            "repo_id": repo_id,
            "issue_pr_id": issue_pr_id,
            "http_status": None,
            "rate_limit_remaining": None,
            "rate_limit_reset_at": None,
            "status": "queued",
            "error_code": None,
            "error_message": None,
            "response_json": None,
            "started_at": None,
            "finished_at": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        tool_calls[-1]["status"] = "running"
        tool_calls[-1]["started_at"] = started
        tool_calls[-1]["updated_at"] = started
        finished = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        tool_calls[-1]["status"] = "failed"

        tool_calls[-1]["finished_at"] = finished
        tool_calls[-1]["updated_at"] = finished
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Thread is already resolved.")

    # Enforce lifecycle transition for github_discussion_artifacts.status
    current = thread.get("status")
    allowed = {
        "active": ["edited", "resolved", "deleted"],
        "edited": ["edited", "resolved", "deleted"],
        "resolved": ["edited", "deleted"],
        "deleted": []
    }
    if current not in allowed or "resolved" not in allowed[current]:
        return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", f"Cannot transition discussion artifact status from {current} to resolved.")

    conn = active_conns[0]
    call_id = "gtc_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    tool_calls.append({
        "id": call_id,
        "connection_id": conn.get("id"),
        "tool_name": "resolve_pull_request_conversation",
        "request_json": {"repo_full_name": repo_full_name, "pull_number": pull_number, "thread_id": thread_id},
        "resolved_repo_full_name": repo_full_name,
        "repo_id": repo_id,
        "issue_pr_id": issue_pr_id,
        "http_status": None,
        "rate_limit_remaining": None,
        "rate_limit_reset_at": None,
        "status": "queued",
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "response_json": None,
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    })
    started = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    tool_calls[-1]["status"] = "running"
    tool_calls[-1]["started_at"] = started
    tool_calls[-1]["updated_at"] = started

    # Mutate thread
    updated = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    thread["thread_resolved"] = True
    thread["status"] = "resolved"
    thread["github_updated_at"] = updated
    thread["updated_at"] = updated
    _save("github_discussion_artifacts.json", artifacts)

    finished = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    tool_calls[-1]["status"] = "succeeded"
    tool_calls[-1]["http_status"] = 200
    tool_calls[-1]["response_json"] = {"thread": {"github_id": thread_id, "artifact_id": thread.get("id"), "status": thread.get("status"), "thread_resolved": True}}
    tool_calls[-1]["finished_at"] = finished
    tool_calls[-1]["updated_at"] = finished
    _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)

    return {
        "thread": thread,
        "meta": {"latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000), "tool_call_id": call_id}
    }

    def _log_tool_call_start(conn_id, request_obj, resolved_repo_full_name=None, repo_id=None, issue_pr_id=None):
        calls = _load("github_tool_calls.json")

    def _log_tool_call_finish(call_id, status, http_status=None, response_json=None, error_code=None, error_message=None, resolved_repo_full_name=None, repo_id=None, issue_pr_id=None):
        calls = _load("github_tool_calls.json")
        finished = _now()
        allowed = {"queued": {"running", "failed"}, "running": {"succeeded", "failed"}, "succeeded": set(), "failed": set()}
        for r in calls:
            if r.get("id") == call_id:
                cur = r.get("status")
                if status not in allowed.get(cur, set()):
                    if "failed" in allowed.get(cur, set()):
                        status = "failed"
                        error_code = error_code or "invalid_transition"
                        error_message = error_message or f"Invalid tool_call status transition {cur}->{status}"
                    else:
                        status = cur
                r["status"] = status
                if status in ("succeeded", "failed"):
                    r["finished_at"] = finished
                r["http_status"] = http_status
                r["response_json"] = response_json
                r["error_code"] = error_code
                r["error_message"] = error_message
                if resolved_repo_full_name is not None:
                    r["resolved_repo_full_name"] = resolved_repo_full_name
                if repo_id is not None:
                    r["repo_id"] = repo_id
                if issue_pr_id is not None:
                    r["issue_pr_id"] = issue_pr_id
                r["updated_at"] = finished
                break
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)

    # Validate
    if not isinstance(repo_full_name, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$", repo_full_name.strip()):

        "github_updated_at": now,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    }

    artifacts.append(art_row)
    _save("github_discussion_artifacts.json", artifacts)

    resp = {

        "repo_full_name": repo_full_name,
        "pull_number": pull_number,
        "github_id": art_row["github_id"],
        "author_login": art_row["author_login"],

    _log_tool_call_finish(call_id, "succeeded", http_status=201, response_json=resp, resolved_repo_full_name=repo_full_name, repo_id=repo_id, issue_pr_id=pr.get("id"))

def update_pull_request_comment(repo_full_name, comment_id, body, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, uuid
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0069000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0069000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    if not isinstance(repo_full_name, str) or not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$", repo_full_name.strip()):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "repo_full_name must be in the form 'owner/name'.")
    repo_full_name = repo_full_name.strip()
    if not isinstance(comment_id, int) or comment_id <= 0:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "comment_id must be a positive integer.")
    if not isinstance(body, str) or body.strip() == "":
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "body must be a non-empty string.")
    body = body

    connections = _load("github_connections.json")
    repos = _load("github_repositories.json")
    issues_prs = _load("github_issues_pull_requests.json")
    artifacts = _load("github_discussion_artifacts.json")
    tool_calls = _load("github_tool_calls.json")

    active_conns = [c for c in connections if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("status") == "active"]
    if not active_conns:
        call_id = "gtc_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        tool_calls.append({
            "id": call_id,
            "connection_id": "unknown",
            "tool_name": "update_pull_request_comment",
            "request_json": {"repo_full_name": repo_full_name, "comment_id": comment_id, "body": body},
            "resolved_repo_full_name": repo_full_name,
            "repo_id": None,
            "issue_pr_id": None,
            "http_status": 401,
            "rate_limit_remaining": None,
            "rate_limit_reset_at": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_code": "unauthorized",
            "error_message": "No active GitHub connection available.",
            "response_json": None,
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active GitHub connection available.")

    repo = next((r for r in repos if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("full_name") == repo_full_name), None)
    if not repo:
        conn = active_conns[0]
        call_id = "gtc_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        tool_calls.append({
            "id": call_id,
            "connection_id": conn.get("id"),
            "tool_name": "update_pull_request_comment",
            "request_json": {"repo_full_name": repo_full_name, "comment_id": comment_id, "body": body},
            "resolved_repo_full_name": repo_full_name,
            "repo_id": None,
            "issue_pr_id": None,
            "http_status": 404,
            "rate_limit_remaining": None,
            "rate_limit_reset_at": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_code": "github_404",
            "error_message": "Repository not found.",
            "response_json": None,
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Repository not found.")

    repo_id = repo.get("id")
    conn = active_conns[0]

    # Find the comment within this repo
    comment = next((a for a in artifacts
                    if isinstance(a, dict)
                    and a.get("repo_id") == repo_id
                    and a.get("artifact_type") == "pr_review_comment"
                    and a.get("github_id") == comment_id
                    and a.get("status") != "deleted"), None)
    if not comment:
        call_id = "gtc_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        tool_calls.append({
            "id": call_id,
            "connection_id": conn.get("id"),
            "tool_name": "update_pull_request_comment",
            "request_json": {"repo_full_name": repo_full_name, "comment_id": comment_id, "body": body},
            "resolved_repo_full_name": repo_full_name,
            "repo_id": repo_id,
            "issue_pr_id": None,
            "http_status": 404,
            "rate_limit_remaining": None,
            "rate_limit_reset_at": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_code": "github_404",
            "error_message": "Comment not found.",
            "response_json": None,
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Comment not found.")

    # Ensure the issue/pr exists and is accessible (FK integrity)
    issue_pr_id = comment.get("issue_pr_id")
    pr = next((p for p in issues_prs if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("id") == issue_pr_id and p.get("repo_id") == repo_id and p.get("status") != "deleted"), None)
    if not pr:
        call_id = "gtc_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        tool_calls.append({
            "id": call_id,
            "connection_id": conn.get("id"),
            "tool_name": "update_pull_request_comment",
            "request_json": {"repo_full_name": repo_full_name, "comment_id": comment_id, "body": body},
            "resolved_repo_full_name": repo_full_name,
            "repo_id": repo_id,
            "issue_pr_id": issue_pr_id,
            "http_status": 404,
            "rate_limit_remaining": None,
            "rate_limit_reset_at": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_code": "github_404",
            "error_message": "Pull request not found for comment.",
            "response_json": None,
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Pull request not found for this comment.")

    # Insert tool call and transition lifecycle
    call_id = "gtc_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    tool_calls.append({
        "id": call_id,
        "connection_id": conn.get("id"),
        "tool_name": "update_pull_request_comment",
        "request_json": {"repo_full_name": repo_full_name, "comment_id": comment_id, "body": body},
        "resolved_repo_full_name": repo_full_name,
        "repo_id": repo_id,
        "issue_pr_id": issue_pr_id,
        "http_status": None,
        "rate_limit_remaining": None,
        "rate_limit_reset_at": None,
        "status": "queued",
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "response_json": None,
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    })
    started = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    tool_calls[-1]["status"] = "running"
    tool_calls[-1]["started_at"] = started
    tool_calls[-1]["updated_at"] = started

    # Update comment body; enforce status transition: active|edited|resolved -> edited allowed, deleted not
    current = comment.get("status")
    allowed = {
        "active": ["edited", "resolved", "deleted"],
        "edited": ["edited", "resolved", "deleted"],
        "resolved": ["edited", "deleted"],
        "deleted": []
    }
    if current not in allowed or "edited" not in allowed[current]:
        finished = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        tool_calls[-1]["status"] = "failed"
        tool_calls[-1]["http_status"] = 409
        tool_calls[-1]["error_code"] = "invalid_transition"
        tool_calls[-1]["error_message"] = f"Cannot edit comment in status '{current}'."
        tool_calls[-1]["finished_at"] = finished
        tool_calls[-1]["updated_at"] = finished
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", f"Cannot edit comment in status '{current}'.")

    updated = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    comment["body"] = body
    comment["status"] = "edited"
    comment["github_updated_at"] = updated
    comment["updated_at"] = updated
    _save("github_discussion_artifacts.json", artifacts)

    finished = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    tool_calls[-1]["status"] = "succeeded"
    tool_calls[-1]["http_status"] = 200
    tool_calls[-1]["response_json"] = {"comment": {"github_id": comment_id, "artifact_id": comment.get("id"), "status": comment.get("status")}}
    tool_calls[-1]["finished_at"] = finished
    tool_calls[-1]["updated_at"] = finished
    _save("github_tool_calls.json", tool_calls)

    return {
        "comment": comment,
        "meta": {"latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000), "tool_call_id": call_id}
    }

Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is unknown or revoked, and FAILED_PRECONDITION if the connection is in error and cannot be used.

def get_connection_self(connection_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0069000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0069000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    # Validate
    if not isinstance(connection_id, str) or not re.match(r"^ghc_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", connection_id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid connection_id.", field="connection_id")

    conns = _load("github_connections.json")
    calls = _load("github_tool_calls.json")

    conn = next((c for c in conns if c.get("id") == connection_id), None)

    # Prepare tool_call row (must exist even on auth failures)
    call_id = None
    try:
        call_id = "ghtc_" + os.urandom(12).hex()
    except Exception:
        call_id = "ghtc_" + str(int(time.time() * 1000))
    tool_call = {
        "id": call_id,
        "connection_id": connection_id,
        "tool_name": "get_connection_self",
        "request_json": {"connection_id": connection_id},
        "resolved_repo_full_name": None,
        "repo_id": None,
        "issue_pr_id": None,
        "http_status": None,
        "rate_limit_remaining": None,
        "rate_limit_reset_at": None,
        "status": "queued",
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "response_json": None,
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    calls.append(tool_call)
    _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)

    # Transition queued -> running
    tool_call["status"] = "running"
    tool_call["started_at"] = now
    tool_call["updated_at"] = now
    _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)

    # Auth / lifecycle enforcement
    if conn is None:
        tool_call["status"] = "failed"
        tool_call["http_status"] = 401
        tool_call["error_code"] = "github_401"
        tool_call["error_message"] = "Unknown connection."
        tool_call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        tool_call["updated_at"] = tool_call["finished_at"]
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Connection is unknown or cannot be used.", connection_id=connection_id)

    if conn.get("status") == "revoked":
        tool_call["status"] = "failed"
        tool_call["http_status"] = 401
        tool_call["error_code"] = "github_401"
        tool_call["error_message"] = "Connection revoked."
        tool_call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        tool_call["updated_at"] = tool_call["finished_at"]
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Connection is unknown or cannot be used.", connection_id=connection_id)

    if conn.get("status") == "error":
        # Spec asks FAILED_PRECONDITION, but contract restricts error codes; use INVALID_TRANSITION.
        tool_call["status"] = "failed"
        tool_call["http_status"] = 412
        tool_call["error_code"] = "failed_precondition"
        tool_call["error_message"] = "Connection is in error state and cannot be used."
        tool_call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        tool_call["updated_at"] = tool_call["finished_at"]
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)
        return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Connection is in error state and cannot be used.", connection_id=connection_id)

    # Rate limit snapshot from last observed tool call for this connection
    last_rl = None
    for tc in reversed(calls):
        if tc.get("connection_id") == connection_id and (tc.get("rate_limit_remaining") is not None or tc.get("rate_limit_reset_at") is not None):
            last_rl = {
                "rate_limit_remaining": tc.get("rate_limit_remaining"),
                "rate_limit_reset_at": tc.get("rate_limit_reset_at"),
            }
            break
    if last_rl is None:
        last_rl = {"rate_limit_remaining": None, "rate_limit_reset_at": None}

    body = {
        "connection": {
            "id": conn.get("id"),
            "provider": conn.get("provider"),
            "github_account_id": conn.get("github_account_id"),
            "github_login": conn.get("github_login"),
            "account_type": conn.get("account_type"),
            "scopes": conn.get("scopes") if isinstance(conn.get("scopes"), list) else [],
            "installation_id": conn.get("installation_id"),
            "status": conn.get("status"),
            "last_verified_at": conn.get("last_verified_at"),
            "created_at": conn.get("created_at"),
            "updated_at": conn.get("updated_at"),
        },
        "rate_limit": last_rl,
    }

    tool_call["status"] = "succeeded"
    tool_call["http_status"] = 200
    tool_call["response_json"] = body
    tool_call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    tool_call["updated_at"] = tool_call["finished_at"]
    _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)

    body["meta"] = {"tool_call_id": call_id, "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)}
    return body

If the repository is missing or stale in cache, this operation may fetch from GitHub and upsert the repository before returning. def get_repository(connection_id, repo_full_name, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0069000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0069000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    # Validate
    if not isinstance(connection_id, str) or not re.match(r"^ghc_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", connection_id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid connection_id.", field="connection_id")
    if not isinstance(repo_full_name, str) or "/" not in repo_full_name or repo_full_name.count("/") != 1:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "repo_full_name must be in 'owner/name' form.", field="repo_full_name")
    owner, name = repo_full_name.split("/", 1)
    if not owner or not name:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "repo_full_name must be in 'owner/name' form.", field="repo_full_name")

    conns = _load("github_connections.json")
    repos = _load("github_repositories.json")
    calls = _load("github_tool_calls.json")

    # Insert tool call queued before any "GitHub contact"
    try:
        call_id = "ghtc_" + os.urandom(12).hex()
    except Exception:
        call_id = "ghtc_" + str(int(time.time() * 1000))

    tool_call = {
        "id": call_id,
        "connection_id": connection_id,
        "tool_name": "get_repository",
        "request_json": {"connection_id": connection_id, "repo_full_name": repo_full_name},
        "resolved_repo_full_name": repo_full_name,
        "repo_id": None,
        "issue_pr_id": None,
        "http_status": None,
        "rate_limit_remaining": None,
        "rate_limit_reset_at": None,
        "status": "queued",
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "response_json": None,
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    calls.append(tool_call)
    _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)

    tool_call["status"] = "running"
    tool_call["started_at"] = now
    tool_call["updated_at"] = now
    _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)

    # Connection must be usable
    conn = next((c for c in conns if c.get("id") == connection_id), None)
    if conn is None or conn.get("status") == "revoked":
        tool_call["status"] = "failed"
        tool_call["http_status"] = 401
        tool_call["error_code"] = "github_401"
        tool_call["error_message"] = "Connection is unknown or revoked."
        tool_call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        tool_call["updated_at"] = tool_call["finished_at"]
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Connection cannot be used.", connection_id=connection_id)

    if conn.get("status") == "error":
        tool_call["status"] = "failed"
        tool_call["http_status"] = 412
        tool_call["error_code"] = "failed_precondition"
        tool_call["error_message"] = "Connection is in error state."
        tool_call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        tool_call["updated_at"] = tool_call["finished_at"]
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)
        return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Connection is in error state and cannot be used.", connection_id=connection_id)

    # Cache lookup
    repo = next((r for r in repos if r.get("full_name") == repo_full_name), None)

    # In this offline implementation, we cannot contact GitHub. If missing, return NOT_FOUND.
    if repo is None:
        tool_call["status"] = "failed"
        tool_call["http_status"] = 404
        tool_call["error_code"] = "github_404"
        tool_call["error_message"] = "Repository not found or access denied."
        tool_call["response_json"] = None
        tool_call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        tool_call["updated_at"] = tool_call["finished_at"]
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Repository does not exist or installation has no access.", repo_full_name=repo_full_name)

    # Enforce that repo's connection reference exists (FK integrity); if broken, treat as error.
    if not any(c.get("id") == repo.get("connection_id") for c in conns):
        tool_call["status"] = "failed"
        tool_call["http_status"] = 500
        tool_call["error_code"] = "fk_violation"
        tool_call["error_message"] = "Cached repository references missing connection."
        tool_call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        tool_call["updated_at"] = tool_call["finished_at"]
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Repository cache is inconsistent (missing connection reference).", repo_id=repo.get("id"))

    # If repo is access_revoked or deleted, behave like no access / not found (per description).
    if repo.get("status") in ("access_revoked", "deleted"):
        tool_call["status"] = "failed"
        tool_call["http_status"] = 404
        tool_call["error_code"] = "github_404"
        tool_call["error_message"] = "Repository not accessible."
        tool_call["repo_id"] = repo.get("id")
        tool_call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        tool_call["updated_at"] = tool_call["finished_at"]
        _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Repository does not exist or installation has no access.", repo_full_name=repo_full_name)

    tool_call["repo_id"] = repo.get("id")
    tool_call["status"] = "succeeded"
    tool_call["http_status"] = 200
    tool_call["response_json"] = repo
    tool_call["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    tool_call["updated_at"] = tool_call["finished_at"]
    _save("github_tool_calls.json", calls)

    return {
        "repository": repo,
        "meta": {"tool_call_id": call_id, "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)},
    }
